in_hebrew.name: רִיצָה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A Hebrew name derived from the root 'ratsach' meaning 'to be rich, to be abundant', or 'to rain'. It is a feminine name, and in the Bible, it is the name of the wife of Boaz (Ruth 4:1-12) and the name of a Canaanite goddess of wealth.

in_greek.name: ῥικκα
in_greek.long_meaning: A Greek name derived from the word 'rhizomai' meaning 'to be rich' or 'to be fertile'. It is a rare name in the Greek Bible, and there is no specific reference to it.

in_latin.name: Ricca
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the word 'ricus' meaning 'rich' or 'wealthy'. It is a rare name in the Latin Bible, and there is no specific reference to it.
